results.name: Mobile preserves classic and ambient gradients in both themes; plain remains an explicit option
Overview totals reconcile, the team keeps roster order after counts change, and missing records do not become a ranking
All task categories and team entries still drill into source records without another data load
An empty scoped period remains explicit, and zero-count staff still open an empty source view
Compact navigation labels are unclipped tooltips with keyboard focus, Escape dismissal and no native-title duplicate
Short desktop rail scrolls expanded tools without horizontal overflow or inaccessible last links
Tooltip transition respects reduced motion and never appears in an expanded sidebar
Overview and calendar remain within real viewport widths; the primary chart is compact on desktop

limitations: Synthetic prototype only; no production data or cloud-read measurement
Physical Safari/iPhone/Android and team comprehension UAT are pending
